<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  The main column of AppShell: the heading, the metric tiles, and the chart panel (beside the activity panel
  when `activity` is given).
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Metric } from "../blocks/metric-row.types";
  import type { Point } from "../blocks/chart-panel.types";
  import type { Event } from "../blocks/activity-feed.types";
  import type { OverviewChart, OverviewActivity } from "../blocks/dashboard-overview.types";

  export type AppMainProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    metrics: Metric[];
    chart: OverviewChart;
    activity?: OverviewActivity;
    cols?: "1-2" | "1-4";
    density?: "default" | "compact";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../compose/Box.svelte";
  import Grid from "../compose/Grid.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Title from "../compose/Title.svelte";
  import BarChart from "../components/bar-chart.svelte";
  import Panel from "../components/panel.svelte";
  import StatTile from "../components/stat-tile.svelte";
  import Timeline from "../components/timeline.svelte";
  import { tpl } from "../utils";

  let { id, title, metrics, chart, activity, cols = "1-2", density = "default" }: AppMainProps = $props();
</script>

<Stack
  gap={(((density as string) === "compact") ? "4" : "6")}
  align="stretch"
  class="min-w-0"
  data-testid="app-main"
>
  <Title as={2} size="2xl" weight="bold" id={tpl("{0}-title", id)}>
    {title}
  </Title>
  {#if ((metrics?.length ?? 0) > 0)}
    <Grid cols={cols} class="gap-4" data-testid="items">
      {#each metrics as m (m.id)}
        <Box data-testid="item">
          <StatTile label={m.label} value={m.value} icon={m.icon} hint={m.hint} />
        </Box>
      {/each}
    </Grid>
  {/if}
  {#if activity}
    <Grid cols="1-2" class="items-stretch gap-4">
      {#if ((chart.series?.length ?? 0) > 0)}
        <Panel title={chart.title} description={chart.text} id={tpl("{0}-chart", id)} class="h-full">
          <BarChart bars={chart.series} label={chart.summary} height={144} />
        </Panel>
      {/if}
      {#if ((activity?.events?.length ?? 0) > 0)}
        <Panel title={activity?.title} description={activity?.text} id={tpl("{0}-feed", id)} class="h-full">
          <Timeline items={activity?.events} />
        </Panel>
      {/if}
    </Grid>
  {:else if ((chart.series?.length ?? 0) > 0)}
    <Panel title={chart.title} description={chart.text} id={tpl("{0}-chart", id)} class="h-full">
      <BarChart bars={chart.series} label={chart.summary} height={144} />
    </Panel>
  {/if}
</Stack>
